title: TaskRaiseRailScope
description: The scope of task.raise_rail (M1 slice plan P17a; §6 L3): an operator raises one of a task's count rails to a higher cap, for that task only, and every budget_rail hold of the task on that rail clears. The USD rails are P17b's; per_day_usd is the project's, raised only by a profile change.

CountRail.description: A count rail of the project profile's budget.rails.

RailCap.description: A raised cap: above the one in force.
